_doc: Single source of truth for active Pro/Mini LLM model assignments. Air was decommissioned on 2026-05-05 and is not an active Ollama node.

_removed_roles_2026_09_21._why: Removed, not repointed: no live consumer for any of them. Verified by grepping get_role/resolve_model_role, direct bracket access, and raw crontabs on both machines. A role naming an absent model that nobody calls keeps the defined<->live probe DIVERGED forever, and a probe that always shouts gets trained out of existence. Recorded here rather than deleted silently, so restoring one is a lookup and not an excavation. Note: get_role() has exactly ONE real consumer in the whole repo (scripts/model_topology.py), which is how seven roles became ghosts without anything breaking.

sentry.why: only reachable from the cell/main.py ram_gb<=16 branch, written for Air (decommissioned 2026-05-05)

translation.why: appears only in federation_capability_table.py as a documentation tag, never resolved as a role

kg_json.why: zero occurrences anywhere outside this file

reasoning.why: every match in the repo is an unrelated JSON field or docstring

cron_fallback.why: cited only in two closed planning docs from April and June 2026

code_review.why: the only matches are independent systems that never read this file (multi_ai_adapter TaskType.CODE_REVIEW routes to Claude; federation_capability_table is a capability tag)

cron_primary_tool_calling.why: zero occurrences in the entire repo outside this file

notes.qwen3.5_tool_calling: BROKEN in Ollama (XML/JSON mismatch #14493). Use qwen3:8b for native tool calling. Our OpenClaw cron does NOT use tools parameter so qwen3.5 is safe.
notes.mini_ram_policy: Mini has 24GB RAM: keep only qwen2.5:7b warm by default. Load qwen3:8b, qwen3.5:9b, or qwen2.5vl:7b cold only for explicit jobs and do not install/use gemma4:26b on Mini.
notes.think_false: Always set think:false for qwen3/3.5 API calls, otherwise content is empty and response goes to thinking field
notes.keep_alive_bug: Always send explicit keep_alive in every API request to prevent timer reset (GitHub #5272)
notes.agy_swarm_commander: Agy Gemini 3.5 Flash High and Gemini 3.1 Pro High are cloud adjunct reviewers only. They run through scripts/agy_swarm_commander.py with hard timeouts, prompt-hash audit, and candidate-only output. They must not write KG nodes, merge identities, request credentials, or scrape private accounts.
